mapper.select: SELECT push_device_id, member_id, device_key, platform, provider, device_name, is_active, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at FROM push_device WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND device_key = #{deviceKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_device ( member_id, device_key, platform, provider, device_name, token_ciphertext, token_hash, is_active, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{deviceKey}, #{platform}, #{provider}, #{deviceName}, #{tokenCiphertext}, #{tokenHash}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform = VALUES(platform), provider = VALUES(provider), device_name = VALUES(device_name), token_ciphertext = VALUES(token_ciphertext), token_hash = VALUES(token_hash), is_active = 1, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT push_device_id, token_ciphertext FROM push_device WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY push_device_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE push_device SET is_active = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE push_device_id = #{pushDeviceId} AND is_active = 1
